subject: Short CTO touchdown window — compress walkthrough?
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sam Chen <sam.chen@acmecorp.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Short CTO touchdown window — compress walkthrough?

Sam — quick heads up: I heard you’ll be on site next Tuesday but only have a short touchdown window (≈40–45 minutes) before your next meeting. Would you be comfortable compressing the technical walkthrough into a 30–35 minute run so we can focus on the items you care about?

If yes, we’ll: 
- Trim the product tour to 10 minutes (key integrations only)
- Reserve 15–20 minutes for performance, security, and your priority checklist (HIPAA/data residency)
- Leave ~5–10 minutes for Q&A and next steps

Two quick options:
1) 13:00–13:35 local — compact run with performance demo first
2) 14:00–14:35 local — compact run with customer-specific case study first

Attached: agenda_v2.pdf and slide-deck.pdf (clean 1-page run-of-show at the front). Hannah/Marcus — can you confirm which option gives us the best sync with your team prep? Monica — if Sam confirms, can your team push the calendar invite to include the 35-minute slot and dial-in?

Thanks,
Logan
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
M: 415-555-0124
logan.wright@redwood.inference.com

Attachments: agenda_v2.pdf (pdf), slide-deck.pdf (pdf)

From: Sam Chen <sam.chen@acmecorp.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@acmecorp.com>, scheduling@acmecorp.com
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 10:03:21 -0800
Subject: Re: Short CTO touchdown window — compress walkthrough?

Hi Logan — thanks for the note. I can make time for a 40-minute block starting at 13:00 local on Tue. I prefer the performance/security-first order — please make sure we cover HIPAA-related processing paths and end-to-end latency at payload sizes we operate with (we're seeing peaks at ~50k qps in our simulated environment).

If you can compress the deck and surface the engineering tradeoffs up front, that will be ideal. Elaine will confirm the invite.

Sam
Sam Chen
CTO, Acme Corp
On Tue, Nov 11, 2025 at 09:12 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Sam — quick heads up: I heard you’ll be on site next Tuesday but only have a short touchdown window...

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 10:20:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Short CTO touchdown window — compress walkthrough?

Noted. We’ll compress the narrative and drop the customer success deep-dive (we can follow up asynchronously). Marcus — can you own the performance portion and bring the latest load test numbers? I’ll tighten the slides to surface only the high-level architecture and the compliance checklist.

I’m adding a provisional invite (calendar_compressed.ics) — please hold until we get Sam/Elaine to confirm, then Monica can push the final invite.

-Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: calendar_compressed.ics (calendar)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
To: scheduling@acmecorp.com, Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Sam Chen <sam.chen@acmecorp.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 12:00:00 -0800
Subject: Confirming compressed 13:00–13:35 slot for Acme technical walkthrough

Hi Elaine / Scheduling team —

Thanks for confirming availability. Per Sam's note, he'd like a performance/security-first flow. Please send a calendar invite for Tue 13:00–13:35 (CTO — Sam Chen) to the attendees below. We will arrive prepared to run to time.

Attendees (requested): Sam Chen, Logan Wright, Hannah Schmitt, Marcus Lin, Monica Patel; plus one ACME engineer (TBD).

Run-of-show (short):
- 13:00–13:05: Quick context & objective (Logan)
- 13:05–13:20: Performance & architecture (Marcus)
- 13:20–13:30: Compliance highlights & Q&A (Hannah)
- 13:30–13:35: Next steps and action items

Link to materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-materials (front-page has the 1-page run-of-show). Monica — can you coordinate the final invite and include the dial-in + drive link?

Appreciate it,
Logan

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Short CTO touchdown window — compress walkthrough? — runbook and test results

All — locking this down. I swapped the microbench demo for a short summary and will do a live tail of the 95th/99th latency charts only if time permits. Attached: runbook.txt and load-test-summary.csv (sanitized numbers). Hannah — I removed a slide on minor integrations and compressed the compliance checklist to one slide.

Logistics: I'll be on Zoom + in person; bring a laptop with the 3-minute perf trace preloaded. We should be able to hit the 35 minute cut cleanly.

Marcus
Marcus Lin | Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: runbook.txt (text), load-test-summary.csv (csv)
